title.zh-TW: 院子裡躲球與球場上守門員躲球
title.en: Dodging a ball in the yard and on the pitch

subtitle.zh-TW: 同樣是閃開一顆球，小明不必負責，守門員大明卻要。
subtitle.en: The same dodge, but Xiao-ming is not blamed while the goalkeeper Da-ming is.

story.zh-TW: 考慮兩個對照的情境。在院子裡，小雄踢球，小明閃開，球砸破了玻璃窗；若小明沒閃開而站在原地，就會擋下球。在足球場上，大雄踢球射門，守門員大明閃開，球進門得分；若大明沒閃開而擋球，球就進不了門。
story.en: Consider two contrasting situations. In a yard, Xiao-xiong kicks a ball, Xiao-ming steps aside, and the ball smashes a window; had Xiao-ming stood his ground he would have stopped it. On a football pitch, Da-xiong kicks at goal, the goalkeeper Da-ming steps aside, and the ball goes in; had Da-ming blocked it, it would not have gone in.

zh-TW.sentence: 在院子裡，小雄踢球，小明閃開，球砸破了玻璃窗；若小明沒閃開而站在原地，就會擋下球。
在足球場上，大雄踢球射門，守門員大明閃開，球進門得分；若大明沒閃開而擋球，球就進不了門。

en.sentence: In a yard, Xiao-xiong kicks a ball, Xiao-ming steps aside, and the ball smashes a window; had Xiao-ming stood his ground he would have stopped it.
On a football pitch, Da-xiong kicks at goal, the goalkeeper Da-ming steps aside, and the ball goes in; had Da-ming blocked it, it would not have gone in.

text.zh-TW: 小明閃開是人之常情，窗戶破了不會算在他頭上；要負責的是朝窗戶踢球的人。
text.en: Stepping aside is what anyone would do; the broken window is not laid to Xiao-ming but to whoever kicked the ball at it.

explanation.zh-TW: 兩個情境並排放在同一個模型裡。院子：K1 是小雄踢球，D1 是小明閃開，窗戶破 W = K1·D1；球場：K2 是大雄踢球，D2 是大明閃開，球進門 G = K2·D2。兩邊都是閃開才讓球通過。簡單的反事實分析把 D1 = 1 與 D2 = 1 都算作原因，但直覺只把 D2 = 1 算作原因。差別來自規範：守門員應該擋球，閃開是偏差；院子裡的人沒有擋球的義務，閃開是常態；同樣，朝窗戶踢球是偏差（K1 的常態為 0），球員射門則是常態（K2 的常態為 1）。引擎的常態版因此只保留 D2 = 1 與 K1 = 1。這些變數與方程式依故事擬定，鄧育仁 (2022) 並無方程式。
explanation.en: The two situations sit side by side in one model. Yard: K1 is Xiao-xiong kicking, D1 is Xiao-ming stepping aside, and the window breaks if W = K1·D1. Pitch: K2 is Da-xiong kicking, D2 is Da-ming stepping aside, and the goal is scored if G = K2·D2. In both, the ball gets through only if the person steps aside. The simple counterfactual analysis counts both D1 = 1 and D2 = 1 as causes, while the intuition counts only D2 = 1. The difference comes from norms: a goalkeeper is supposed to block, so stepping aside is deviant, whereas nobody in a yard is obliged to block, so stepping aside is the default; likewise kicking at a window is deviant (K1 is normally 0), while a player shooting is normal (K2 is normally 1). The normality-based definition therefore keeps only D2 = 1 and K1 = 1. The variables and equations are built from the story; Teng (2022) gives no equations.

sources.citation: Wang, P.-H. (2025). The linkage between causation and responsibility: a normative perspective [Yinguo yu zeren de liandong; in Chinese]. EurAmerica, 55(2), 227–271.

note.zh-TW: p.232 轉述鄧育仁 (2022: 212–213) 的院子情境與球場情境；p.233 說明兩者的因果與責任判斷為何不同：守門員的角色規範。鄧育仁《公民哲學》原書未取得，此處據王鵬翔的轉述。
note.en: P. 232 relays the yard and pitch situations from Teng (2022: 212–213); p. 233 explains why the causal and responsibility judgments differ: the goalkeeper's role norm. Teng's book itself was not available; this follows Wang's report.
